q: The Thurston-Douady-Hubbard classification via Hubbard trees: for a postcritically finite polynomial f (all critical orbits are finite), the combinatorial type is captured by:
opts: The Hubbard tree: a finite invariant tree containing the postcritical set, on which f acts as a graph map with specific topological properties
The rotation number of the Siegel disk
exp: Hubbard tree: for a postcritically finite polynomial, the convex hull of the postcritical set in the filled Julia set K(f) is a finite invariant tree (the Hubbard tree). The restriction of f to the tree encodes the combinatorics of the polynomial up to topological conjugacy. Thurston's algorithm reconstructs f from the Hubbard tree.
